title: Walk Every Page
story: APIs return results in pages. Keep asking until there is no next page.
goal: Write collect(get) that gathers every item. get(page) returns {"items": [...], "next": page or None}.
hints: Start at page 1, then follow the next value.
Loop while page is not None.

def collect(get):
    items = []
    page = 1
    while page is not None:
        data = get(page)
        items.extend(data["items"])
        page = data["next"]
    return items
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?

alt:
def collect(get):
    items, page = [], 1
    while page:
        r = get(page)
        items += r["items"]
        page = r["next"]
    return items
